positions.description: Skills: Oracle Xstore · Java · Spring Framework · SQL · Soti Mobicontrol · Verifone · Powershell

positions.title: Hardware Deployment Technician
positions.description: A week long project in which I was assigned to configuring, deploying, and troubleshooting various devices and peripherals (i.e. laptops, monitors, barcode scanners, and label printers)

positions.title: Desktop Support Specialist
positions.description:
Worked on the Cooperative Services Desktop Support (CSDS) Equipment Lifecycle Replacement (ELR) project replacing old computers around campus that had expended their warranties. (Summer 2018 and Summer 2019)
• Participated in and executed one of the largest IT related projects at Purdue University
• Was one of two team leaders appointed to replacing computers that were old and outliving their warranties
• Frequently troubleshot issues with new and old computers and various peripherals and other computer-related equipment
• Guided a team of student employees and appointed tasks to students to maximize efficiency and productivity
• Performed QA on new machines that had been imaged and populated with the proper software before deployment
• Used SCCM to add necessary software and printers to new devices
• Resolved software issues with the following: Microsoft Office 365, Microsoft Outlook, Windows 7, Windows 10, user authorization, and various other specialist applications

positions.title: Student IT Technician
positions.description:
Worked on the Cooperative Services Desktop Support (CSDS) Equipment Lifecycle Replacement (ELR) project replacing old computers around campus that had expended their warranties.
• Preceded my TEKsystems IT Consultant position
• Performed similar work to the TEKsystems position but as a student member of the team.
• Replaced old computers and troubleshot various technical issues, both software and hardware-related

positions.title: Dishwasher/Host
positions.description:
• Performed duties that a restaurant host normally would, i.e. seating guests, dealing with complaints, cleaning, etc.
• Cleaned dishes as a dishwasher and made pizzas
• Learned new teamworking skills and strengthened leadership abilities

positions.title: CalRob Collegiate Painting
positions.description:
• Member of a 4-man painting team
• Performed exterior painting on various outdoor structures like houses, docks, decks, and garages
• Strengthened teamworking and efficiency skills by distributing work amongst myself and other painters

projects.title: Equipment Lifecycle Replacement (ELR)
projects.description: Replaced around 800 old computers around the Purdue University campus.

projects.title: Functional Website Creation
projects.description: Contributed to a large project of ~30 students in which individuals were separated by their degrees and skills in order to create a functional website that referenced a database and was accessible on servers through a network.
